chaining: 300 GB x unlimited transfers, but retention is 3-100 days, so accumulation requires a re-upload loop. Useful as a transit leg, not a store.
limits_note: 300 GB per transfer, 100 files per transfer, retention selectable 3 to 100 days then auto-delete. Every upload is security-scanned before publish, so flagged content never appears.

reliability_note: Retention max 100 days plus a mandatory malware scan on every file makes this a transfer service; a large binary dataset may be held for scanning before the link works.
